file_stem: RWB TE 008 Decision log hash chain check
title: Decision log hash chain check
module: P7 Decision center and log (technical enabler)
goal: Recompute the decision-log hash chain every night, so any tampering is reported to Compliance the same day
why: Append-only is enforced by the database (E1-008); this job proves it every night. A break names the first bad entry and opens an incident.
triggers: Waits for JOB-13 (decision log copy), by 04:00
ace_note: No ACE read. It reads only the Workbench decision log.
stores: ACE job run record; ACE notification path; incident; Quartz

functions.name: HashChainCheckJob
functions.does: no concurrent run; waits for JOB-13

rules: BR1: a nightly check with a same-day report
BR3: covers chain_seq 1 to the maximum at the start of the run
BR4: runs after JOB-13, starting by 04:00
BR6: one active run; a rerun is a new record
risks: Hash mismatch -> BROKEN + incident to Compliance (MSG-P7-008)
example: If entry 30,005 were tampered -> BROKEN at 30,005
